blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Philippine Olympic Committee president Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino is confident that Team Philippines will thrive in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Hours before the opening ceremony, Tolentino, who set a target of eight gold medals, expressed his excitement, as the Asiad is set to go full blast starting on Sunday. “Hopefully. We’re praying for that. Hopefully, we can get through and even double our medal haul. That’s everyone’s dream,” said Tolentino in Filipino.
